changelog:
Faster settings, same settings: the catalog of CSM rows is built once instead of being rebuilt, re-scanned and re-copied on every settings page.
One hub build now reads the stored values and the unfiltered row ranking once, instead of once per area row and per category count, and search ranks every row once instead of re-ranking both rows of every comparison.
Nothing visible changed: same rows, same counts, same search order - only less work behind them.
message: Dev build v862 - the settings hub reads its own state once per build
